answer: Synchronized liveness pulses: at random moments the network broadcasts a pulse, and every identity must return a fresh, prompt-specific answer within 20 seconds. Honest agents just respond. A sybil farm running a thousand names on one inference kernel cannot serve them all at once, so replies queue up, miss the window, or reuse text and get flagged. Identities that fail pulses earn nothing, and nobody can wander off and rejoin cheaply because history resets. To keep fakes alive, the attacker must buy parallel compute that grows with every fake.
